messages:
mica: quick check-in on streaming UX — I'm torn between a tiny live dot + token badge vs a compact pill that expands to a detailed token breakdown. mock here: https://img.redwood.dev/tmp/live-dot-pill (mock)
diego: tiny live dot feels modern but hides counts. pill gives immediate info. can we combine?
tay: combine idea: live dot near avatar + pill collapsed at right. pill defaults to rounded (1.2k) and expands on click/focus to full integers. reduces width impact.
mica: yes, collapsed + expandable is the plan. expansion must be accessible (keyboard focusable) and not hover-only.
ravi: accessibility checklist: focusable element, aria-expanded toggles, aria-controls to the details panel, aria-live=polite for updates. don't announce every token increment. debounce announcements to ~350ms.
diego: behavior for stop/regenerate? current comps show two inline buttons. proposal: keep stop visible during stream, show regenerate after stream completes. both small icons + labels with tooltips for clarity.
tay: good. also allow keyboard shortcuts: Esc for stop, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter to regenerate. add tooltip text with shortcut.
a11y-bot: note — ensure contrast ratio for pill text is >=4.5:1 and focus ring meets WCAG visible focus requirements. file a ticket for manual screen reader testing on VoiceOver + NVDA.
mica: token formatting: compact (pill) use abbreviated SI (e.g., 2.1k). expanded shows exact numbers and a cache badge if prefixes were reused. cache badge should have accessible name like "prefix cache: 40%".
ravi: for aria-live: use role=status region and update only on debounced values. when stream finishes announce "Response ready". when user stops, announce "Generation stopped".
diego: microcopy: change "My prompts" to "Saved prompts" in prompt drawer, and empty state: "Save a prompt to reuse it across your workspace."
tay: layout note: prompt drawer remains right-rail on desktop, bottom-sheet on mobile widths. ensure focus trap when drawer is open and ESC closes it. list items should be arrow-key navigable.
mica: motion: avoid long transitions. expand/collapse instant but respect prefers-reduced-motion. initial streaming shimmer limited to first 300ms, then token deltas appear.
ravi: accessibility test cases: 1) keyboard only: focus pill, expand, verify aria-live region updates; 2) screen reader: ensure final announcement only; 3) contrast & focus ring. I'll create the a11y ticket after spec.
diego: telemetry events: ui.token_pill_expand, ui.stop_clicked, ui.regen_clicked, ui.promptdrawer_open. include viewport size to segment mobile/desktop.
mica: will produce a 1-page spec + updated comps by EOD PST and include color tokens and keyboard mappings. thanks team :sparkles:
a11y-bot: reminder — attach NVDA/VoiceOver test steps to the a11y ticket.
